description: Drop nested environment (canvasGroupRefs/meta) from volumeInstance GET. Alchemy only needs instance scalars plus volume { id, name, projectId }.

patches.value:
query volumeInstance($id: String!) {
  volumeInstance(id: $id) {
    createdAt
    currentSizeMB
    deletedAt
    environmentId
    externalId
    id
    isPendingDeletion
    mountPath
    region
    serviceId
    sizeMB
    state
    volume {
      createdAt
      id
      name
      projectId
    }
    volumeId
  }
}
